subject: Text Similarity
source_sentence: Most of the approaches of determining text similarity use word similarity .
title: Comparing Word Relatedness Measures Based on Google n-grams

subject: Measures
source_sentence: These measures generally use co-occurrence statistics (mostly word n-grams and their frequencies) of target words generated from a corpus to form probability estimates.
title: Comparing Word Relatedness Measures Based on Google n-grams

subject: Search Engine
object: web page count of target words
source_sentence: There are other corpus-based measures that use web page count of target words from search engine as co-occurrence statistics (e.g., Iosif and Potamianos, 2010; Cilibrasi and Vitanyi, 2007; Turney, 2001).
title: Comparing Word Relatedness Measures Based on Google n-grams

subject: Corpus-based approaches
source_sentence: Corpus-based approaches to measuring word relatedness generally use co-occurrence statistics (mostly word n-grams) of a target word from a corpus in which it occurs and then these co-occurrence statistics may be used to form probability estimates.
title: Comparing Word Relatedness Measures Based on Google n-grams

subject: Measures
source_sentence: These measures use some co-occurrence statistics which are not available in the Google n-gram corpus.
